title: org.x402 UCP Payment Handler Entry
description: Vendor-neutral x402 payment handler entry for UCP discovery. Facilitator detail is deliberately absent: the facilitator is merchant-side configuration. Network identifiers are CAIP-2 chain ids (namespace:reference, e.g. eip155:8453, solana:5eykt4UsFv8P8NJdTREpY1vzqKqZKvdp, bip122:000000000019d6689c085ae165831e93). Asset identifiers are chain-specific (EVM: 0x-address; SVM: base58 mint pubkey; etc.) and are constrained by the conditional rules below.

items.description: CAIP-2 chain id: namespace:reference per CAIP-2 grammar. Examples: eip155:8453 (Base), eip155:47763 (Neo X), eip155:84532 (Base Sepolia), solana:5eykt4UsFv8P8NJdTREpY1vzqKqZKvdp (Solana mainnet), bip122:000000000019d6689c085ae165831e93 (Bitcoin). Non-blockchain networks may follow CAIP-2-style ids (e.g. ach:us, sepa:eu) per x402 v2. The binding does not constrain which namespaces a merchant may advertise; support for a namespace is between the merchant and its facilitator.

network.description: CAIP-2 chain id; MUST appear in x402.networks.

asset.description: Chain-specific asset identifier in the notation native to the asset's network. EVM: contract address (0x + 40 hex). SVM: base58 token mint public key. Others: the identifier defined by the corresponding x402 scheme binding for that network. Shape is validated conditionally on the asset's own network namespace, see the allOf rules inside this item schema.

decimals.description: Smallest-unit exponent of the asset (10^-decimals). For networks without a decimal denomination concept (e.g. native BTC via bip122), use 0 and treat the asset as integer units.

allOf.$comment: SVM assets: base58, 32-44 chars (token mint pubkey)

maxAmount.description: Ceiling for a single payment, integer base units (no decimals).

quoteWindow.description: Seconds a quoted total stays locked once issued. Default 600.

items.description: x402 payment scheme identifier. The scheme registry is open and extensible (see coinbase/x402 specs/schemes/). Known today: exact, upto, batch-settlement. New schemes may be added by the x402 standard over time; consumers MUST ignore unrecognized scheme ids. Ordered by merchant preference.
